title: Global Strategy and Operations Senior Associate, YouTube Shopping
descriptionHtml:
The YouTube Business Product Activation Team is responsible for bringing product to market and market to product. The team works closely with both business and product leaders to scale adoption of YouTube products across the partner and creator ecosystem.

The core capabilities of the team include: designing go-to-market strategies, identifying and prioritizing product activation opportunities across the business, ensuring launch readiness, defining and driving execution on product activation across segments, understanding needs of partners and creators to provide Product teams with market feedback and prioritization to shape product roadmaps, developing content strategy, collecting and synthesizing user feedback, and tracking performance.

The Shopping Product Activation team brings YouTube's Shopping product to market and the market to product. We answer tough questions to grow our Shopping business - For which users, creators, or partners is our Shopping product most relevant? What is the business case for the product (e.g., market value proposition, potential headroom)? What will it take to launch and land the product (e.g., GTM levers, messaging, comms)? What creators/partners do we need to prioritize and how?

Video commerce is revolutionizing the way that people decide what to buy. The YouTube Shopping team is at the forefront of this shift: connecting viewers to products they’ll love through the creators that they trust.

And, it's working: people watch over 30 billion hours of shopping-related videos on YouTube in a year. We are partnering with some of the worlds largest retailers, trusted brands, and store builders.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Senior Silicon Engineer, HBM Memory Subsystem Design, Integration and Validation
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, you will be part of a team developing ASICs used to accelerate and improve traffic efficiency in data centers. You will collaborate with members of architecture, verification, power and performance, and physical design to deliver high quality designs for next generation data center accelerators. You will solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic solutions, and evaluate design options with complexity, performance, power and area in mind.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Define microarchitecture and develop high-quality RTL for memory controller frontends, guiding implementation trade-offs across performance, area, power, timing, and configurability for multi-channel and pseudo-channel configurations.
  • Lead the design, integration, and delivery of complex memory controller backends and HBM/DDR PHY macros, owning quality closure (DFI pipe wrappers, clock/reset, PLL references, sideband bridging) and schedule from concept to tapeout.
  • Collaborate with DV teams to build test plans, improve coverage, and validate design intent (UVM, emulation, ECC/RAS error injection), while tracking JEDEC specs and memory conferences for the latest HBM trends.
  • Lead and support ATE testing, first-silicon lab bring-up, and physical characterization of the HBM PHY and controller across PVT (process, voltage, temperature) corners.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to engineers while promoting best practices in RTL design, review, documentation, methodology, and systematic root-cause debug.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in memory subsystem design, integration or verification.
  • Experience with DRAM protocols (HBM2e/HBM3/HBM4 or DDR/LPDDR4x/5/5X) including Joint Electron Device Engineering Council (JEDEC) timing, refresh and training sequences.
  • Experience with the DFI controller-to-PHY interface, leading a feature or IP block, and mentoring engineers.
  • Experience in SystemVerilog RTL, simulation and debug flows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Experience delivering configurable, reusable IP-parameterization, release packaging, integration guides and customer-facing documentation.
  • Experience integrating third-party controller and PHY IP (Rambus, Cadence/Synopsys class) into production silicon.
  • Experience with SECDED per pseudo-channel, Reed–Solomon symbol correction, error queues, lane/row repair, address-folded CRC.
  • Experience with UVM methodology and emulation-based pre-silicon validation, and familiarity with memory telemetry and Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) — per-pseudo-channel counters, link availability, continuous eye-opening monitors.

title: SOC Quality and Reliability Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

Google’s data centers are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help build the SoC’s that power these data centers by driving quality and reliability processes from the integrated circuit perspective. You will create silicon and follow it into the field (and back) to drive improvements for the next generations of chips.

You will have an understanding of IC flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, yield, reliability, and failure analysis. You will work with various cross functional teams to develop quality and reliability specifications, develop and deploy design guidelines, and develop and execute and test plans. Within the larger organization you will collaborate with global hardware quality and reliability teams, silicon design, validation and engineering teams.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the strategic definition and development of design-for-reliability (DfR) guidelines, collaborating with cross-functional subject matter experts to integrate reliability into early design stages.
  • Define and lead the development of qualification hardware and test methodologies, managing internal teams and external vendors to ensure silicon and package verification.
  • Execute comprehensive silicon and package qualification programs (including high-temperature operating life (HTOL), early life failure rate (ELFR), electrostatic discharge/latch-up (ESD/LU), biased highly accelerated stress test (b/HAST), etc.) and conduct failure analysis to resolve quality issues.
  • Extract and analyze data from qualification programs, high-volume manufacturing, and field returns to identify failure mechanisms and trends for yield and reliability optimization.
  • Develop and implement physics-based statistical Quality and Reliability models (e.g., ELF, time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), negative bias temperature instability (NBTI) to predict device failure mechanisms and lifetime behaviors.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in IC silicon quality or reliability.
  • Experience leading the product reliability lifecycle from post-tapeout through high-volume manufacturing.
  • Experience with semiconductor complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology, device physics, and failure mechanisms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related field.
  • Expertise in statistical data analysis using tools such as JMP, Python, or JSL.
  • Knowledge of design-for-reliability (DfR) rules and implementation techniques.
  • Familiarity with electrical failure analysis (EFA) and physical failure analysis (PFA) techniques.
  • Track record with silicon reliability on process nodes and advanced packaging technologies.

title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations (Swing, Night, Weekend shifts)
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Signal and Power Integrity Engineer
descriptionHtml:

You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

Collaborating within a cross-functional team, including Chip Design, IP, System Design, software, and vendors, you will drive signal and power design implementations on chip and advanced packages.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate high-speed interface IPs and develop next-generation memory interfaces across IO PHY, SI/PI, and physical design boundaries.
  • Drive post-silicon validation and qualification for NPI, balancing SI/PI performance and DFM constraints to achieve final package design closure.
  • Partner closely with silicon, system, and external vendor teams while developing simulation methodologies to boost modeling accuracy and efficiency.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience in industry SIPI modeling tool chains e.g., HFSS, ADS, Sigrity, Siwave, etc.
  • Experience with lab bring-up, test environments, and characterization for high-speed memory and SerDes.
  • Experience with partnering across chip architecture, physical design, static timing analysis (STA), package, and validation teams.
  • Experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ to establish automated flows and data processing tools.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Direct experience with silicon interposers, silicon bridges, and 3D die stacking architectures.
  • Deep knowledge of SI/PI analysis for high-speed interconnects (HBMx, D2D/chiplets, PCIe, SerDes) and timing budget methodologies.

title: Product Manager, AdSpam Conversion and Bidding Integrity, Google Ads
descriptionHtml:
Ad fraud is one of the biggest challenges facing the digital advertising industry across web, app, video, and beyond. AdSpam’s mission is to protect advertisers, users, publishers, and Google from fraud and abuse. We prevent the exploitation of Google’s ad systems for monetary gain, collaborate across the industry to combat fraud beyond Google, and safeguard business against sophisticated, persistent, and globally distributed threats to ensure the long-term health of a free and open digital ecosystem.

Google’s advertising business increasingly relies on automated campaign strategies powered by AI bidding and optimization models. These systems automatically place ads to drive real business results—such as purchases, app installs, and leads (conversions). However, their effectiveness depends entirely on the integrity of their training data. When fraudsters manipulate conversion signals or generate fake activity, these models can be tricked into directing advertiser spend toward fraudulent or low-value inventory.

The Conversions and Bidding Integrity team directly addresses this challenge. As a Product Manager, you will protect the critical signals feeding Google’s business generation and bidding models from advanced abuse, complementing broader Invalid Traffic (IVT) defenses to steer advertiser budgets away from risk and toward genuine business value.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Identify emerging fraud vectors and design product strategies to protect automated bidding algorithms and conversion measurement from manipulation.

descriptionHtml:

  • Proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment and influencing outcomes through data-driven insights and analysis.
  • Established track record of fostering collaboration across various, matrixed stakeholder groups.

title: Chuyên viên thương mại, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược, Đông Nam Á
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google tại Đông Nam Á (SEA) tiếp sức cho các doanh nghiệp hàng đầu nâng cao doanh thu kỹ thuật số trong bối cảnh thương mại ưu tiên AI. Khi hành trình mua sắm kỹ thuật số phát triển trên khắp các sàn thương mại điện tử, cửa hàng trực tuyến của thương hiệu và mạng lưới nhà xuất bản bên ngoài sàn thương mại, nhóm của chúng tôi giúp các thương hiệu lớn trong lĩnh vực bán lẻ, hàng tiêu dùng đóng gói sẵn (CPG), công nghệ và bán hàng trực tiếp đến người tiêu dùng (D2C) nắm bắt nhu cầu của những khách hàng có ý định cao và tối đa hoá lợi tức đầu tư trực tuyến.

Nhóm Chuyên viên sản phẩm tập trung vào việc mang lại kết quả có thể đo lường và tối đa hoá lợi tức đầu tư cho khách hàng trên toàn bộ phễu tiếp thị bằng các giải pháp về đo lường, hiệu suất và quảng cáo thương hiệu.

Là một Chuyên viên thương mại, bạn sẽ đóng vai trò như một chuyên gia chuyên trách về thương mại và chuyên môn sâu cho lĩnh vực thương mại trực tuyến và mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại (CMN) ở khắp Đông Nam Á. Bạn sẽ hợp tác với các nhà quảng cáo thương hiệu hàng đầu, nhà bán lẻ trực tuyến thuần tuý và nhà điều hành mạng lưới truyền thông để đẩy nhanh việc áp dụng công nghệ quảng cáo thương mại tiên tiến, cơ sở hạ tầng dữ liệu sản phẩm và các giải pháp kiếm tiền từ đối tượng bên ngoài sàn thương mại. Bạn sẽ chẩn đoán phễu chuyển đổi trực tuyến, thúc đẩy tốc độ giao dịch trên web/ứng dụng và sàn thương mại điện tử, đồng thời xúc tiến các mục tiêu kinh doanh quan trọng cho đối tác của chúng tôi bằng các giải pháp của Google.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Thúc đẩy các chiến lược thương mại trên các mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại, chiến dịch Tìm kiếm, Tạo nhu cầu và Tối đa hoá hiệu suất để đạt được các mục tiêu về GMV, ROAS và tỷ lệ thu nạp của khách hàng trên khắp Đông Nam Á.
  • Hợp tác với các nhà bán lẻ kỹ thuật số và sàn thương mại điện tử hàng đầu để thiết kế, mở rộng quy mô và tạo ra cơ hội kinh doanh từ các giải pháp truyền thông thương mại bên ngoài sàn thương mại bằng cơ sở hạ tầng quảng cáo và tín hiệu về đối tượng của Google.
  • Đẩy nhanh việc áp dụng các công cụ thương mại dựa trên AI của Google và hướng dẫn nhà quảng cáo về việc đặt giá thầu nâng cao, tích hợp dữ liệu của bên thứ nhất và cấu trúc chiến dịch toàn phễu.
  • Xây dựng kế hoạch kinh doanh chung, cẩm nang và khung thuyết trình để nâng cao kỹ năng cho các nhóm quản lý tài khoản của LCS và công ty quảng cáo về việc tạo ra cơ hội kinh doanh thương mại và mở rộng quy mô hiệu suất.
  • Đóng vai trò một chuyên gia có chuyên môn sâu ở khu vực về lĩnh vực truyền thông bán lẻ kỹ thuật số, tổng hợp các xu hướng thị trường ở Đông Nam Á để cung cấp thông tin và tác động đến lộ trình sản phẩm toàn cầu.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực mạng truyền thông bán lẻ (RMN/CMN), quảng cáo thương mại kỹ thuật số, thương mại video hoặc tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất trong một nền tảng thương mại điện tử hoặc hệ sinh thái công nghệ.
  • Kinh nghiệm lập kế hoạch truyền thông kỹ thuật số cho các thương hiệu hàng tiêu dùng đóng gói sẵn (CPG), sàn thương mại điện tử trực tuyến hoặc nhà bán hàng thương mại điện tử thuần tuý.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm thực tiễn về video có thể mua sắm, thương mại qua hình thức phát trực tiếp và hệ sinh thái thương mại trên mạng xã hội, thúc đẩy hành trình từ khám phá đến thanh toán trên toàn phễu.
  • Thành tích đã được chứng minh trong việc mở rộng quy mô các giải pháp quảng cáo thương mại trực tuyến, bao gồm cả quảng cáo được tài trợ trên sàn thương mại, mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại (CMN) bên ngoài sàn thương mại hoặc các chương trình tạo ra hoạt động kinh doanh trên sàn thương mại điện tử.
  • Kỹ năng giao tiếp và quản lý nhân sự xuất sắc, cùng khả năng tác động đến các bên liên quan ở mọi cấp bậc.
  • Kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt, có khả năng rút ra thông tin chi tiết hữu ích từ dữ liệu.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để trao đổi với các bên liên quan trong hoạt động kinh doanh.

title: Contracts Manager, Transformation and Excellence, Google Procurement Organization
descriptionHtml:
In the Google Procurement Organization (GPO), our aim is to unlock value to reinvest in what matters most. We bring velocity, efficiency, and security to buying, partnering deeply across business units to deliver forward-looking commercial solutions.

Within GPO, the Commercial Operations team is reimagining the future of source-to-pay. We are seeking a transformational Contracts Manager who blends foundational commercial and contract management expertise with a digital-first mindset. In this role, you will not only steer complex agreements across key domains (e.g., Marketing, Professional Services), but also serve as a catalyst for procurement modernization. You will identify opportunities to deploy AI-enabled workflows, intelligent agreement analytics, and automated clause extraction to compress cycle times, elevate risk intelligence, and scale contracting excellence globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $136000 - $196000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end contracting strategy for high-complexity, high-impact engagements; structure agreements to protect business interests, capture supplier innovation, and optimize total cost.
  • Partner cross-functionally to pilot and scale AI-powered contract lifecycle management (CLM) solutions—including automated clause generation, intake triage, risk scoring, and post-signature obligation monitoring.
  • Design scalable workflows that strategically leverage extended workforce resources, self-service playbooks, and managed service partners to shift internal bandwidth from routine drafting to negotiation.
  • Serve as a business partner across Category Management, Legal, Security, Compliance, and executive stakeholders, establishing clear governance and agile negotiation frameworks.
  • Monitor modern contracting metrics (e.g., cycle time velocity, clause deviation rates, automation adoption, compliance leakage) to iteratively optimize contracting standards and operating models.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Law or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in contract management, operations, or procurement, with direct exposure to commercial transactions.
  • Experience leading or contributing to procurement modernization initiatives regarding contract lifecycle management (CLM) implementations, or process re-engineering projects.
  • Experience with structuring and negotiating commercial terms in domains such as Marketing, Professional Services, or Technology.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., CCMP, CPCM, WCC).
  • Experience evaluating or deploying emerging digital tools and generative AI applications within legal tech or procurement (e.g., AI-assisted redlining, intelligent repository discovery, contract intelligence platforms).
  • Strong change-management background with experience driving adoption of new technologies, playbooks, and operating models across global teams.
  • Expertise in vendor risk frameworks, data privacy, IP governance, and multi-region regulatory landscapes.
  • Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate operational bottlenecks into digital/AI roadmap opportunities.

title: Strategic Partnerships Development Manager, YouTube Product Partnerships, Living Room
descriptionHtml:
Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

YouTube's global Living Room Product Partnerships team works cross-functionally with internal teams to identify, structure, and execute multi-faceted distribution agreements, while developing relationships with our most mature device partners to drive the distribution of YouTube's suite of services (YouTube Main App, YouTube TV, YouTube Premium, and Primetime Channels). Identify partnership opportunities to aid product development that will drive incremental watch time, daily active users and subscribers.

In this role, you will require a deep understanding of the connected TV and gaming console landscape, knowledge of product integration, thought leadership, influencing skills, research and analysis skills, flawless execution, and a passion for working in the fast-moving area of connected TV content services. Most importantly, you know how to assess partnership opportunities, define a strategy, and work closely with internal and external stakeholders to drive partnerships that help the business evolve.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $140000 - $203000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Structure partnerships, draft terms, lead negotiations, and execute term sheets on behalf of YouTube.
  • Lead and make decisions amidst cross-functional, organizational, and industry complexity, with an ability to bring open issues to resolution.
  • Build and manage cross-functional relationships with YouTube Product, Engineering, and Partner Engineering groups to support their respective team initiatives.
  • Build detailed industry category strategy plans and account plans, organize and execute QBRs with top partners, and drive YouTube presence at key industry conferences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in business development, partnerships, management consulting, or investment banking.
  • 6 years of experience in business development, Over-the-Top (OTT) app distribution, the streaming video industry, and consumer electronic device partnerships.
  • Experience working with C-level executives and cross-functionally across all levels of management.
  • Experience managing agreements or partnerships.
  • Experience in a partner-facing role, analyzing and structuring negotiations, and negotiating and executing with consumer electronic device manufacturers.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience deploying or distributing 'over the top' (OTT) video apps on consumer electronic devices.
  • Demonstrated experience thriving in ambiguous environments; excellent people management communication and negotiation skills with the ability to provide insightful, data-driven strategic recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Understanding of connected TV platforms and the consumer electronics hardware industry (as it relates to video streaming technologies).
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to develop customized term sheets, work with legal agreements, and clearly present distilled agreement issues to executive management when appropriate.

title: Senior Security Manager, Senior Executive Services, Leadership Support Services
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Security Manager with Leadership Support Services (LSS)-Senior Executive Services, you will use your knowledge and experience in security management to coordinate and support appropriate risk based mitigation services for Alphabet Leadership on a case by case basis. In addition, you will be expected to cultivate and maintain working relationships with all internal stakeholders, administrative staff, government agencies, and third-party vendors to effectively manage and drive crisis communications; develop written materials and content to efficiently relay critical information to all stakeholders, conduct security advances and facilitate protective services, facilitate personal security vulnerability assessments and ensure quality control of all services rendered while tracking program performance.

From keeping Googlers safe and secure to managing disruptive events, the ability to anticipate, deter, detect, and act are the pillars of Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team. As a member of GSRS you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. You will help us continually identify, evaluate and monitor enterprise risks that could affect business activities and provide business leaders the information they need to make critical decisions. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to create innovative strategies and develop programs that drive sustainable effectiveness.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $157000 - $227000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary security advisor for designated executives, tailoring guidance to their unique needs and concerns. Lead executive protection details as necessary, ensuring the comprehensive safety and security of assigned individuals in all situations and locations.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Executive Services Section to bolster security measures and response capabilities. Foster strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders to develop and implement agile, effective security strategies.
  • Manage relationships with external security vendors, ensuring seamless support for executive protection, travel, events, and any emergent security issues.
  • Analyze comprehensive security assessments and deliver tailored briefings to executives, focusing on identified vulnerabilities and recommended mitigation strategies. 
  • Ensure seamless and adequately resourced logistical support for designated executives. 

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • 10 years of experience in security, law enforcement, or military that includes executive or dignitary protection responsibilities.
  • Operational experience in Executive/Dignitary Protection on a global level.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Law Enforcement Officers Safety Act (LEOSA) qualified.
  • 5 years of experience analyzing intelligence and threat reports to determine the risk level to a location, event, or person so that resources can be scoped appropriately.
  • 5 years of experience with Executive Protection/Dignitary Protection or event security operations documents.
  • Executive Protection/Dignitary Protection (EP/DP) accreditation.
  • Ability to work flexible or non-standard corporate schedules (including holidays) and travel (up to 50% of the time) domestically/internationally, if needed.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Outcome Engineering
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) for Cloud AI, you will lead the end-to-end technical program management of critical customer bugs, technical blockers, and product defect escalations across Generative AI workloads and platform services. You will serve as the essential technical bridge connecting customer-facing field teams (Account Teams, Customer Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Support) with Product Management and Core Engineering.

In this role, you will establish and govern standardized issue intake channels, drive rigorous technical triage, hold product engineering accountable for resolutions and committed ETAs, and lead operational reviews and executive reporting cadences—ultimately driving customer satisfaction and moving customer sentiment to sustained green.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Own and orchestrate the technical lifecycle for identifying, tracking, prioritizing, and resolving complex customer bugs, technical blockers, and product defect escalations across Generative AI solutions and platform services from initial intake through engineering fix and production verification.
  • Act as the primary technical liaison between field teams, Product and Core Engineering; work directly with software engineers, product managers, and infrastructure leads to drive rapid root-cause analysis, negotiate engineering backlog prioritization, resolve critical defects, or secure realistic, committed resolution dates.
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated reporting frameworks, dashboards, and operational telemetry tracking key metrics; deliver concise, high-signal briefings to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Advocate the customer experience and act as the escalation quarterback for high-priority accounts; proactively resolve systemic technical friction points to protect adoption and contract momentum, driving at-risk accounts to sustained green customer sentiment.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in technical program management, software engineering, or technical product management.
  • Experience managing bug, blocker, and incident resolution workflows for enterprise customers in cloud, AI/ML, or distributed systems environments.
  • Experience with Generative AI technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI infrastructure, APIs, or enterprise platform integrations.
  • Experience collaborating with customer-facing field teams (Account Teams, Customer Engineers, and Solutions Architects) and Core Engineering/Product teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience designing and operating large-scale cross-functional governance structures, bug triage cadences, intake channels, and SLA/SLO frameworks across global engineering and field organizations.
  • Experience establishing operational telemetry, building real-time dashboards, and delivering high-visibility executive reviews on blocker burn-down, MTTR, and engineering.
  • Ability to understand, debug, and discuss cloud architectures, GenAI model serving, API integrations, latency/throughput constraints, and distributed systems at the architecture and code level with software engineers.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with ability to influence without authority across various engineering, product, and field sales organizations.

title: Program Manager, AI Transparency Reporting
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust and Safety (T&S) is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. In the AI Transparency Reporting team, we look to deliver critical AI-related transparency reporting and establish reporting systems that are consistent, scalable and sustainable across Google.

As a Program Manager in Google's AI Transparency Reporting team within Trust and Safety, you will ensure the transparency and accountability of Google's AI systems to regulators and key opinion formers worldwide, delivering reporting that works across Google’s product ecosystem. You will contribute to critical projects in the fast-moving AI Transparency Reporting space, collaborating extensively with cross-functional partners across Google to identify requirements, drive alignment, and deliver complex regulatory reports.
You will serve as an expert in AI Transparency, translating complex technical concepts into clear, plain language for regulators and key opinion formers, ultimately ensuring that Google's transparency efforts are consistent, scalable, and sustainable across all products and services.
In addition to delivering transparency reporting, this role also involves supporting strategic initiatives to continuously improve AI Transparency Reporting processes.
This is a rapidly evolving space. To be effective in this role, you must be adept at creative thinking, solving new problems and agile execution at startup speed. You will stay informed about the dynamic regulatory landscape, industry trends, and internal operations and communicate solution based recommendations to executives and drive innovative solutions.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $111000 - $159000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze incoming AI regulatory reporting requirements and prepare for operational deliverables across the team.
  • Manage the coordination and delivery of AI regulatory reporting requirements, working closely with other members of the Regulatory Reporting team.
  • Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders to share insights and developments and coordinate on joint deliverables.
  • Operationalize new and existing regulatory reporting processes, utilizing AI where possible, to maximize scale and efficiency and minimize risk.
  • Establish leadership presence and execute against strategic programs for the team, including transparency site.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in program or project management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Strong knowledge of the AI landscape: product development and key policy issues.
  • Ability to manage and coordinate projects with changing requirements, competing demands, inputs from multiple stakeholders and external deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and complete deliverables, consulting subject matter experts.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills. Able to build relationships, align across multiple functions and effectively manage expectations.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills with attention to detail in an ever-changing environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Able to craft clear and concise narratives for reports and supporting documentation and tailor communications to inform and influence different stakeholders.

title: Data Center Technician, Global Data Center Server Operations
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g. Machine Learning platforms, network architecture).
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently. Independently execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
  • Work shifts to meet evolving business needs and operational schedules.
  • Collaborate with the partner teams (e.g., Program Managers, Data Center Operations, and Software and Hardware Engineers) to complete tasks, and to escalate and resolve defined problems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience with assembly of computer systems component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
  • Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.
  • Experience with networking protocols.
  • Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience demonstrating proficiency in troubleshooting hardware and network issues using Linux tools (e.g., LPIC-1, CCNA, or equivalent industry certifications/experience).
  • Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
  • Experience in maintenance of server and storage systems.
  • Understanding of networking concepts, including topology and protocols.
  • Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

title: Customer Engineering Manager, Advanced Technology, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Practice Customer Engineering (CE) Manager, you will lead and deploy a team of subject matter experts responsible for working alongside our customers to provide trusted technical and solution advice to accelerate workload migration and remove technical blockers. You will foster a culture of technical excellence and understand the mechanics of architecture, delivery, and consumption within your specialized domain and Google Cloud’s products and solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Senior DFT Design/Micro Architect Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems. As a Design for Testing (DFT) micro-architect/design engineer, you will support the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. The team develops from the lowest levels of circuit design to large system design and sees those systems all the way through to high-volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our data centers, affecting millions of Google users.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Develop DFT strategy and architecture (e.g., hierarchical DFT, DFT for high-speed I/Os, Analog DFT).
  • Develop and drive die-level DFT validation strategy, complete all Test Design Rule Checks (TDRC), and execute design changes to fix TDRC violations to achieve high test quality.
  • Insert DFT logic, boundary scan, scan chains, DFT Compression, Logic BIST, TAP controller, Clock Control block, and other DFT IP blocks.
  • Document DFT architecture, test sequences, and boot-up sequences associated with test pins.
  • Generate and deliver production and debug patterns to the post-silicon engineering team, and run diagnosis for post-silicon support.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in the implementation and validation of DFT technologies.
  • Experience with multiple projects in DFT design and verification, DFT specification, definition, architecture, and insertion.
  • Experience with DFT techniques and tools, ASIC DFT synthesis, simulation, and verification flow.
  • Experience in leading DFT activities throughout an ASIC development flow.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in IP integration (e.g., memories, test controllers, Test Access Point (TAP), and DFT for Multi die SoCs).
  • Experience in fault modeling.
  • Experience in SoC cycles, silicon bringup, and silicon debug activities.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Stubby C++
descriptionHtml:

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Cloud

title: Quản lý phát triển đối tác chiến lược, Quan hệ đối tác hệ sinh thái Android
descriptionHtml:
Google luôn nỗ lực phát triển các dòng sản phẩm và dịch vụ của mình cho khách hàng. Nhóm Phát triển quan hệ đối tác chịu trách nhiệm tìm kiếm và khám phá cơ hội mới với các đối tác của Google. Với sự nhạy bén trong kinh doanh và kiến thức sâu rộng về sản phẩm, bạn sẽ là người trực tiếp làm việc với các đối tác của chúng tôi, giúp họ tìm ra cách tăng trưởng thông qua các dịch vụ và sản phẩm mới nhất của Google. Kiến thức của bạn về những ngành dọc có liên quan và mối quan hệ với các bên chủ chốt trong ngành sẽ góp phần định hình các ứng dụng và nội dung chất lượng cao của chúng tôi cho các sản phẩm như YouTube, Google TV và Commerce.

Với vai trò là Quản lý phát triển quan hệ đối tác chiến lược, bạn sẽ đi đầu trong việc thúc đẩy tăng trưởng cho Android cũng như các dòng sản phẩm nền tảng và thiết bị trong lĩnh vực viễn thông, nhà sản xuất thiết bị gốc (OEM) và bán lẻ. Bạn sẽ chịu trách nhiệm thiết kế các chiến lược hợp tác và thực hiện các thoả thuận phức tạp, đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc thúc đẩy nỗ lực thu nạp người dùng và phát triển kinh doanh của chúng tôi trong khu vực cùng với các đối tác. Là thành viên của nhóm Phát triển kinh doanh Android tại Châu Á – Thái Bình Dương, bạn sẽ phối hợp chặt chẽ với các nhóm Sản phẩm, Kỹ thuật, Tiếp thị và Pháp lý của Android về các sáng kiến mới và các mối quan hệ chiến lược quan trọng. Trong vai trò này, bạn sẽ xác định các xu hướng trong ngành và những người có tầm ảnh hưởng lớn, đồng thời quản lý quy trình từ đầu đến cuối.

Android là hệ điều hành di động của Google, hỗ trợ hơn 3 tỷ thiết bị trên toàn thế giới. Android mang sức mạnh điện toán đến cho mọi người trên thế giới. Chúng tôi tin rằng điện toán là một nguồn sức mạnh to lớn mang lại những giá trị tốt đẹp, tạo điều kiện tiếp cận thông tin, cơ hội kinh tế, nâng cao năng suất, kết nối giữa bạn bè và gia đình và nhiều lợi ích khác. Chúng tôi cho rằng mọi người trên thế giới đều có quyền tiếp cận những lợi ích tốt nhất mà công nghệ điện toán mang lại. Chúng tôi cung cấp nền tảng cho các nhà sản xuất thiết bị gốc (OEM) và nhà phát triển để xây dựng các thiết bị điện toán hấp dẫn (điện thoại thông minh, máy tính bảng, TV, thiết bị đeo, v.v.) chạy các ứng dụng/dịch vụ tốt nhất cho mọi người trên thế giới.

Responsibilities

  • Xác định và theo đuổi các cơ hội hợp tác mới để phát triển và tạo ra hoạt động kinh doanh cho hệ sinh thái Android, phù hợp với các mục tiêu chiến lược của Google về nền tảng và thiết bị.
  • Thu thập, tổng hợp và chia sẻ ý kiến phản hồi thực tiễn của đối tác trong nước cũng như các xu hướng của thị trường/quốc gia để thúc đẩy hiệu suất của toàn bộ Android cũng như Nền tảng và Thiết bị (P&D), đồng thời hợp tác với các phòng ban liên ngành để giải quyết và giảm thiểu các thách thức trong nước.
  • Nâng cao hiệu quả hoạt động trong mọi khía cạnh của mối quan hệ đối tác, thường xuyên đánh giá hoạt động kinh doanh, tích hợp thoả thuận, quản lý các vấn đề được chuyển lên cấp trên, v.v. Đóng vai trò là cầu nối chính để tiếp nhận ý kiến phản hồi và hiểu biết sâu sắc của đối tác.
  • Dẫn dắt các sáng kiến kinh doanh phức tạp, liên ngành từ khâu lên ý tưởng đến khi ra mắt, đảm bảo các sáng kiến này được triển khai đúng hạn và đạt tiêu chuẩn cao.
  • Chỉ đạo việc thống nhất các tiến độ, mục đích và mục tiêu của nhóm nội bộ. Hợp tác với các nhóm Sản phẩm, Kỹ thuật, Pháp lý, Tiếp thị và các nhóm khác để thực hiện chiến lược tổng thể về Nền tảng và Thiết bị.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 7 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực phát triển kinh doanh, quan hệ đối tác, tư vấn quản lý hoặc ngân hàng đầu tư.
  • 7 năm kinh nghiệm trong ngành nhà mạng di động/nhà sản xuất thiết bị gốc (OEM).
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc với quản lý cấp cao và các phòng ban liên ngành ở mọi cấp quản lý.
  • Kinh nghiệm quản lý các thoả thuận hoặc quan hệ đối tác.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Khả năng giao tiếp lưu loát bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để điều phối và hỗ trợ các mối quan hệ đối tác trong nước ở các thị trường Đông Nam Á (SEA).
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc tại thị trường Việt Nam và Pakistan.
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc độc lập trong một môi trường năng động, không ngừng thay đổi và giàu tính hợp tác.
  • Kinh nghiệm quản lý các mối quan hệ đối tác phức tạp từ đầu đến cuối.
  • Khả năng xác định các cơ hội kinh doanh tiềm năng, đánh giá lợi ích tài chính/kinh doanh, xây dựng thoả thuận và thảo luận các điều khoản với đối tác chiến lược.

title: Staff Mechanical Engineer, Debug
descriptionHtml:

title: Research Engineer, Live Experiment Analysis
descriptionHtml:

Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and model launch analysis.
  • Work cross-functionally on data collection, management, quality measurement and improvements.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

You will partner with the Google data center Engineering team, hardware operations, network Infrastructure and third-party data center vendors and operators with a focus on operability, maintainability and reliability.

In this role, you will be the advocate for operations organization, and be responsible to ensure operability, maintainability and reliability are critical criteria for Google assets.

From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. Ours is a high visibility and exponentially growing space. Our optimization products directly inform where Google should make its next-generation data center investments.

We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

title: Staff Technical Threat Investigator, Trust and Safety Intel Investigations
descriptionHtml:
In this role, your mission is to identify the highest-severity and emerging, on-platform T&S abuse and conduct technical investigative analysis to drive cross-Product Area (xPA) detection, mitigation and remediation measures.

As a part of the team of technical investigators, you will work to proactively hunt out the biggest and baddest threat actors in the Trust and Safety space, deeply understand how they achieve their objectives on Googles family of products and services. You will then work with partner teams to stop the threat actors from being effective by deploying both network-scoped disruptions and scaled detection and enforcement mitigations.

As a Staff Engineering Analyst Investigator, you will serve as a technical lead and domain authority for the team, setting multi-quarter technical direction to uncover systemic threat actor ecosystems and architecting scalable, AI-first investigative and enforcement solutions across Google. You will look beyond individual cases to identify systemic, multi-product area adversarial ecosystems, leading open-ended investigations and multi-quarter disruption programs from initial discovery through executive alignment and cross-Product Area (xPA) operationalization. You will bridge experimental threat research and production-scale defense by designing modular, maintainable automation, data pipelines, and agentic AI architectures in partnership with Software Engineering (SWE) and Data Engineering teams. You will act as a technical multiplier who elevates team-wide investigative tradecraft, codifying methodologies into self-service playbooks, reviewing peers' code and technical designs, and mentoring analysts.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $188000 - $274000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and lead investigations into sophisticated emerging actor networks and behaviors across Google’s ecosystem by correlating complex internal telemetry, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and third-party intelligence at scale.
  • Define the technical strategy and design for technology-enabled automation, building modular, production-grade SQL and Python pipelines, Large Language Model (LLM)/agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks to support proactive threat discovery .
  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Product leads across Product Areas to uplevel abuse-fighting infrastructure, implement high-precision signals, and optimize detection systems’ performance.
  • Author business requirements and technical designs, negotiate shared roadmaps and resource commitments across partners, and align competing priorities into cohesive defense strategies .
  • Review exposure to graphic, controversial, or objectionable material (including child exploitation, graphic violence, self-injury, severe fraud/scams, and other disturbing content).

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Intelligence Studies, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in data analysis, cybersecurity, or technical threat investigations, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative datasets.
  • 7 years of experience utilizing SQL, Python, or similar scripting/programming languages to query datasets, build data pipelines, and solve engineering and abuse-detection problems
  • 7 years of experience managing projects, including defining multi-quarter project scope, goals, and deliverables in a globally distributed environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experiencing designing, deploying, and evaluating production-grade AI/LLM solutions to optimize investigative workflows and scale abuse detection and enforcement.
  • Experience partnering with Software Engineering and Data Science teams to design security/abuse controls, engineer signals and features, and evaluate detection performance.
  • Experience elevating team-wide standards by codifying repeatable threat-modeling playbooks, conducting peer code/design reviews, and mentoring junior-to-senior analysts.
  • Deep expertise in tracking and disrupting sophisticated trust and safety threats, criminal syndicates, scaled fraud/scams, account-based abuse, violent extremism, etc.
  • Has led multi-organization, cross-Product Area initiatives, authoring technical requirements, influencing engineering roadmaps, and aligning stakeholders across competing priorities.

title: Research Scientist, Generative Media and Multimodal LLM
descriptionHtml:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

In this role, you will conduct research on multimodal LLM and agentic workflows for generative media. Collaborating closely with visual generation researchers, you will focus primarily on the language and reasoning side of multimodal generation and multi-turn editing—designing and post-training models that understand nuanced user intent, ground generation using search and external tools, evaluate output quality via reward models and automated judges, and generalize across various languages and writing systems.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct fundamental and applied research on multimodal LLMs and agentic workflows for generative media, including multi-turn reasoning, planning, instruction following, and tool use.
  • Design, prototype, and run experiments on post-training and alignment methods (such as fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and synthetic data curation) to improve model quality, faithfulness, and controllability.
  • Define data pipelines, benchmarks, reward models, and evaluation metrics for multimodal generation and interactive editing under minimal guidance, refining hypotheses through empirical analysis.
  • Identify and investigate research opportunities in multilingual, cross-lingual, and cross-script multimodal modeling, collaborating with internal teams to shape research strategy and expand impact.
  • Author research papers to share findings in the research community, and partner with Engineering teams to transfer promising research into Google products.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with research projects in Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Multimodal Machine Learning.
  • One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of coding experience.
  • 1 year of experience owning and initiating research agendas.
  • Research experience or publications in LLM agents (planning, reasoning, tool use, retrieval-augmented generation), multimodal vision-language models, multilingual NLP, or post-training and alignment (fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, reward modeling).

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based Interns. Benefits for this role include:

  • Health, dental, vision insurance
  • Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
  • Holidays: 13 paid days per year

This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.

Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

---

The Student Researcher Program fosters academic collaborations by hiring students onto research projects aligned to company priorities in scientific advancement. The program offers placements on teams across Google, for research, engineering, and science roles. As a Student Researcher, you will have the opportunity to participate in research projects focused on developing solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.

Student Researcher projects are exploratory and experiences that drive scientific advancement across a multitude of research areas. Students will work collaboratively on projects that explore innovative research challenges and support the creation of breakthrough technologies.

Projects vary in duration and location based on team and student requirements. It is required that you are located in one of the specific country locations identified for this role for the full duration of the engagement. When you apply, you will be considered for Student Researcher positions across all of Google's research teams including DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud and more. This allows us to find the right project match for your skills and interests.

Researchers across Google are working to advance the state of the art in computing and build the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we invest in foundational research and work on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Whether we're shaping the future of sustainability, optimizing algorithms, or pioneering AI systems, our teams strive to continuously progress science, advance society, and improve the lives of billions of people.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $118000 - $157000 (USD) + 0% bonus target

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in research to develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science, Linguistics, Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Natural Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • Experience in one area of computer science (e.g., Natural Language Understanding, Human Computer Interactions, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Quantum Information Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or similar areas).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a full-time degree program and returning to the program after completion of the internship.
  • Currently attending a degree program in the United States.
  • Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.
  • Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in major conferences or journals.
  • Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, C/C++, etc.).

title: Data Science and Analytics Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

As a Data Science and Analytics Specialist, you will possess a strong technical and coding foundation—specifically in SQL, Python, or equivalent, and data pipeline management—and are eager to apply these skills within the domain of consumer insights (market insights for our Marketing organization). You will bridge the gap between traditional market research and data analysis. You will focus on completing tasks within the scope of larger analytical outcomes, utilizing an analytical mindset to manage large, complex datasets.

Your contributions will be direct and task-oriented, operating under the general guidance of a manager or senior researcher. Google will provide you with comprehensive training and mentorship in market research methodologies, primary/secondary data analytics, and the art of building compelling insight narratives. You will assist in the research and application of data-driven insights that have a tangible impact on marketing performance, such as business case development and trend analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Execute research and analysis tasks within the scope of broader, mission-critical marketing projects.
  • Select appropriate research or analysis methods, tools, and processes from options provided by senior team members to address specific technical challenges.
  • Support senior key decision-makers by delivering research and analysis insights that clarify implications for projects, programs, or services.
  • Assist in conducting research and measurement to support and improve overall marketing performance and organizational thinking.
  • Utilise AI capabilities (e.g. Jetski) to create tools as required for the communication or analysis and reporting of key product or marketing metrics.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience in statistical (e.g., R, S-Plus, SAS, Python or similar) and database software (e.g., SQL or equivalent).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or a relevant PhD degree.
  • Foundational experience with data visualization tools (e.g., charts, graphs, dashboard creation), and interest or foundational training in market research methodologies (quantitative and qualitative).
  • Understanding of the full market research lifecycle, including working with external agencies, drafting RFPs, and reviewing survey questionnaires or discussion guides.
  • Ability to critically evaluate data and translate technical analytics into non-technical, persuasive business reports and commentary.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Content Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Search Content Platforms' mission is to understand and organize the world's content to power the best Search+ experiences, enabling disparate sources and modalities of content accessible and connected.

In the first decade, Google’s mission was to organize web content and connect users to information via 10 blue links. In the next decade, we built an answer engine and a rich set of domain-specific, immersive (vertical) Search experiences. Now, we offer an AI-forward, multimodal information experience, leveraging broader content availability and the advances in AI capabilities to harvest and organize our content.The mission is to build a content platform that uses AI to minimize or eliminate the effort for both content providers to share their content with Google, and vertical teams to expose the content to users.
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Responsibilities

  • Drive and own deep technical problems with cross Search and Google impact.
  • Help establishing our Content as a Service offer.
  • Collaborate with other local Search/Knowledge and Information leaders to make Sao Paulo a center of engineering excellence for the broader organization.
  • Help teams establish technical understanding and trust needed to succeed and execute on ambitious goals in Search.
  • Mentor and develop team members on technical and non-technical skills to create a high functioning, high trust, exceptional team.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.
  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience with extract, transform, and load (ETL), data architecture, and system integration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
